newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African gunmen kill four in Zulu region - police.
newsitem.headline: S.African gunmen kill four in Zulu region - police.

text.p: Gunmen shot dead four people in two suspected political attacks in South Africa's Zulu heartland over the past two days, police said on Saturday.

Both attacks occurred in the Donnybrook area of St. Charles in the KwaZulu-Natal region which has recently been the scene of intense feuding between President Nelson Mandela's African National Congress and the Zulu Inkatha Freedom Party.
In the first incident, three gunmen opened fire on a house late on Friday, killing two people and wounding three children, a police commander said.
On Saturday morning two gunman fired at a second house in the area, killing two residents and wounding a third person, he added.
